fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.about: The error code, or 0 if there was no error.

fields.name: TokenRequesterPrincipalType
fields.about: The principal type of the requester of the token.

fields.name: TokenRequesterPrincipalName
fields.about: The principal type of the requester of the token.

fields.name: IssueTimestamp
fields.about: The token issue timestamp in milliseconds.

fields.name: ExpiryTimestamp
fields.about: The token expiry timestamp in milliseconds.

fields.name: MaxTimestamp
fields.about: The token maximum timestamp length in milliseconds.

fields.name: Renewers
fields.about: Those who are able to renew this token before it expires.

fields.name: ThrottleTimeMs
fields.about: The duration in milliseconds for which the request was throttled due to a quota violation, or zero if the request did not violate any quota.
